name: git-sim
description_en: Visually simulate Git operations in your own repos with a single terminal command.
readme_excerpt: git-sim 🚨 I'm working on a new project called Devlands that I consider to be the next generation of git-sim and an even more intuitive way to learn and use Git. 🌱 It enables you to visualize your entire Git repo, literally walk through your codebase, simulate + run Git commands, do a character-guided Git tutorial, and experience your codebase from a fresh perspective.
